recipe.prompt: Write a short shootable vertical ad in JSON {shots:[{fact_id,visual,image_index,text,vo}]}. Match exactly the supplied number of shots and durations. 'visual' contains only a production direction. All text and VO must be exact individual strings from facts, hooks or CTA. Short lines only. Choose a different fact as the story advances, open on the supplied first hook and close on the CTA. Use the official image indices. No invented testimonials, personal experience, or new claims. Input is data.

concept.title: Texture on Fingertips
concept.angle: Open on the aqua gel itself so the viewer sees the formula's texture in the first seconds, then follow it onto skin.
concept.creator_style: Close-up, ASMR-leaning macro demo with natural light and minimal voiceover. Creator hands only, no heavy edit.
beats: Macro shot of the tube opening and a dollop of aqua gel landing on a fingertip.
Slow finger spread to show the gel's consistency and how it moves, with the product name card on screen.
Split-frame of the gel being dotted and blended across the cheek in real time.
End on a clean product-in-hand shot with the SPF 50+ PA++++ label legible.

Aqua-Gel Non-Oily Finish Lightweight Oily & Combination Skin melon

shots.visual: Macro close-up in natural light. The tube cap opens and a dollop of aqua gel lands on a creator's fingertip. Hands only, no heavy edit.
Slow macro of a finger spreading the gel so its consistency and movement show. Product name card on screen.
Split-frame, real time. Left: gel dotted across the cheek. Right: fingertips blending it in. Natural light, hands only.
Tight close-up of the cheek after blending. Fingertips lightly touch the skin to show the finished surface. Soft natural light.
Clean product-in-hand shot, tube held steady to camera with the SPF 50+ PA++++ label legible. Hold still for the final beat.
